items.docs: Create or update the Widget Bundle. Widget Bundle represents a group(bundle) of widgets. Widgets are grouped into bundle by type or use case.  When creating the bundle, platform generates Widget Bundle Id as [time-based UUID](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universally_unique_identifier#Version_1_(date-time_and_MAC_address)).
